card.title: Talk Around the Mess
card.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which label colour suits these boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'd better choose a colour the driver likes.

mechanism: A uses label aesthetics to keep the conversation away from entirely unpacked moving boxes.
confusable: Unlike sensible planning, the detail must remain the focus even after the central neglected responsibility becomes urgent.
comparison: D38-b pulls the arriving driver into color selection; D38-a pulls Mum's cleaning visit into towel aesthetics.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
